newsitem.title: UK: Orange jumps on plans to raise BT calls cost.
newsitem.headline: Orange jumps on plans to raise BT calls cost.

text.p: Shares in Orange Plc and Mercury Communications advanced on Thursday after a newspaper said the companies planned to raise the cost of calls from BT to their mobile phone systems.
Shares in Orange were 12-1/2p better at 181-1/2p by 0901 GMT and Cable and Wireless gained 4-1/2p to 452-1/2p.
The Daily Telegraph newspaper said that from February the cost of British Telecom calls to Orange and One 2 One mobile phones will almost double.
Shares in British Telecommunications were up 1-1/2p at 388p.

The newspaper said the move will enable the mobile phone operators to get a bigger proportion of revenue from BT for the calls that end up on their network. The increase will be passed on to BT customers.
